findings.character_context: Android 17 has Smile Charge in an in-game preset; Android 17 (DB Super) exposes Smile Charge in Partner Customization.
findings.acquisition: For the customizable Android 17 (DB Super) partner, Customization Unlock Key 8 unlocks the partner and Smile Charge can then be purchased in Partner Customization.
findings.mechanics: Grab, rush, single-hit, mid-range, knockback; documented as Strike damage despite the Ki-wave visual component.
